title: Supervisor corrective repair: packet documented-test-command authority wiring (defect A) + revoke-all/status open_asks reconciliation (defect B) - D-014
objective: Repair two source-confirmed supervisor defects that failed run_M0_T063_A1 closed: (A) production _run_loop builds TaskAuthority.from_packet without documented_test_commands, so no packet command can ever earn the documented-test AUTO classification (audit: 3x ASK:undocumented_command); define ONE canonical, closed, schema-validated task-packet field for documented baseline/test commands, load it validated and fail-closed in _run_loop, and prove production wiring with a regression test (AS-1..AS-7, AS-10). (B) broker.revoke_all revokes approval records but nothing ever resolves queued_asks rows, so cmd_status open_asks lists revoked requests as open actionable questions; reconcile revoke-all and status so revoked requests are never presented as actionable while historical audit evidence is preserved, including read-time labeling so the EXISTING A1 runtime database (which must not be mutated) reports correctly (AS-8, AS-9). Qualifying evidence (supervisor-freeze s2): a reproduced defect + inability to complete an authorized product task - run_M0_T063_A1 (controller 0.4.0-phase4) ended PAUSED_RECOVERY with three ASK-classified Bash commands, exit 1, no checkpoint, no Codex review; A1 worktree clean at de2f224a7db16405edfc0e2f2f0902f5164819a0; owner revoke-all reported revoked=3 yet status still lists the three revoked requests under open_asks (live journal: 3 queued_asks with answered_at_utc empty while all 3 approval records are REVOKED). No general Bash allowlist, no broad executable grant, no settings bypass, no always-allow (AS-6); fail-closed behavior must not weaken (prohibition 5).
business_reason: D-014 owner authorization 2026-08-18: bounded control-plane repair so the accepted supervised Codex/Claude loop can execute documented task test commands and report approval state truthfully; unblocks a future authorized A1 re-run without repeating its cost.
inputs: tools/agent_supervisor/policy.py TaskAuthority.from_packet + _auto_test_command + _shape_matches (existing documented-test classification, reused not replaced)
project-control/tasks/M0-T063.json (fixture source for the exact baseline/test-command need; NEVER modified)
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/schemas/task_packet_commands.schema.json - closed schema for the canonical documented_test_commands task-packet field
tools/agent_supervisor/policy.py - fail-closed validator/loader for the canonical field (deterministic; empty/wrong-type/chaining/substitution/redirection/metacharacter/malformed never AUTO)

tools/agent_supervisor/cli.py - _run_loop loads validated packet commands and passes them into TaskAuthority; status reconciles queued asks against approval-record state at read time (labels revoked history; never mutates the journal)
tools/agent_supervisor/broker.py + durable_state.py - revoke_all resolves matching queued_asks rows durably (rows preserved as revoked history)
tools/test_agent_supervisor_command_authority.py - AS-1..AS-10 tests incl. production-wiring regression and revoke/status lifecycle
tools/agent_supervisor/fixtures/m0_t063_documented_test_command.json - M0-T063-shaped bounded fixture (intended command AUTO; altered/injected variants not)
project-control/reports/M0-T070-incident-evidence.md - run_M0_T063_A1 incident evidence (audit chain + read-only journal facts)
project-control/reports/M0-T070-before-after-evidence.md - AS-12 before/after classification + checkpoint-progression + bounded measurement evidence

acceptance_scenarios.name: canonical closed schema-validated packet field
acceptance_scenarios.given: a task packet with documented_test_commands present/absent/malformed
acceptance_scenarios.when: the packet is loaded for a production run
acceptance_scenarios.then: exactly one canonical field name is accepted; schema validation rejects non-list, non-string, empty-string, oversized, and unknown-shape content; absence yields an empty tuple (fail closed), never a default grant

acceptance_scenarios.name: production _run_loop wiring
acceptance_scenarios.then: the validated commands are passed into TaskAuthority.from_packet and reach policy evaluation

acceptance_scenarios.name: deterministic fail-closed authorization
acceptance_scenarios.given: empty values, wrong types, shell chaining, substitution, redirection, unexpected metacharacters, malformed commands
acceptance_scenarios.then: no such input ever gains AUTO authority

acceptance_scenarios.name: documented shape earns existing AUTO
acceptance_scenarios.given: a command exactly matching an explicitly documented and validated shape
acceptance_scenarios.then: it receives the EXISTING documented_test_command AUTO classification (S4.1), advisory-eligible as today

acceptance_scenarios.name: variants remain ASK/HARD_DENY
acceptance_scenarios.given: changed executable, changed arguments, appended command, undocumented command, or a command outside task authority
acceptance_scenarios.then: classification remains ASK or HARD_DENY under existing policy

acceptance_scenarios.name: no broad grants
acceptance_scenarios.then: no general Bash allowlist, broad executable grant, settings-file bypass, or automatic always-allow exists

acceptance_scenarios.name: production-wiring regression test
acceptance_scenarios.given: the authority-construction path used by the real loop
acceptance_scenarios.then: it proves packet commands reach that authority (not only a direct TaskAuthority unit test) and fails if the wiring regresses

acceptance_scenarios.name: revoke/status reconciliation
acceptance_scenarios.given: pending asks whose approvals are then revoked by revoke-all
acceptance_scenarios.when: status is read (including against a pre-fix journal that cannot be mutated)
acceptance_scenarios.then: revoked requests are never presented as currently open actionable requests; historical audit evidence is preserved

acceptance_scenarios.name: lifecycle tests
acceptance_scenarios.then: tests prove: pending appears open; revoke-all revokes; pending-approvals returns zero; status no longer shows it actionable or labels it revoked history; audit chain and journal integrity remain valid

acceptance_scenarios.name: M0-T063 fixture
acceptance_scenarios.given: a fixture with the exact M0-T063 baseline/test-command need
acceptance_scenarios.when: policy evaluates the intended command and altered/injected variants
acceptance_scenarios.then: the intended command is authorized; every altered/injected variant is not

acceptance_scenarios.name: full suites at gate profile
acceptance_scenarios.when: the full supervisor, directive-compliance, and project-control suites run
acceptance_scenarios.then: all pass; the M0-T039 freeze baseline (>=1165 tests, 0 failures) is re-established

acceptance_scenarios.name: before/after bounded evidence
acceptance_scenarios.given: bounded fixtures only (never a repeat of the real A1 run)
acceptance_scenarios.then: before/after classification, checkpoint progression, and available token/runtime measurements are recorded

risks: supervisor-freeze: any tools/agent_supervisor/** change shifts the frozen tree hash; the M0-T039 suite baseline must be re-established under G0/G2/G3/G5 (qualifying evidence cited in packet + commit)
prohibition 3: the live A1 runtime SQLite database must never be mutated; status-side reconciliation must be read-only
AS-6/prohibition 5: the fix must not broaden Bash authority or weaken fail-closed behavior
